issues.issue: Entity treated as an entirely business-type hospital, so all lines are business-type and governmental fields are null. The form shows only property tax, state aid and one 'Operating Expenses' line (no patient service revenue), so this looks like a tax-levying health services district that funds care rather than a hospital operating an enterprise; governmental classification is arguable. Applies to all receipts/disbursements and business_type balances
Beginning balance taken as 0 from dashes; extractor's note that this is a new district is an inference (column 1 is also all dashes), not stated on the page
Fiscal year end assumed by the extractor; not printed on the form
